verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents experimentation and Bayesian winner highlighting, but those are UI-facing capabilities. Its programmatic surfaces are scoped elsewhere in the evidence: the MCP server covers flags, AgentControl configs and observability data, and the CLI covers flags, members, projects and environments. Neither is documented as exposing experiment configurations or results. Generic read-scoped API tokens are a building block, not evidence that agents can read experiment outcomes.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can read experiment configurations and results programmatically to summarize outcomes and recommend ship/rollback decisions
